title: mentha × villosa var. morrenii
intro: Mentha × villosa var. morrenii, commonly known as Pineapple Mint or Bergamot Mint, is a natural hybrid of the Peppermint and Watermint plants, known for its unique flavor and fragrance. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestion, as well as alleviating symptoms of nausea and headaches. The therapeutic actions of Mentha × villosa var. morrenii are attributed to its ability to relax muscles, reduce stress, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include menthone, limonene, and geraniol, which contribute to its medicinal properties and distinctive aroma.
